content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IPA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.ipa.org.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the IPA Senior Consultant / Consultant posts is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Senior Consultant and Consultant in the Indian Ports Association.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (full-time) or above in specified fields like Economics, Public Policy, Maritime, Trade, Transport Management, or International Relations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for the posts is between 25 years and 45 years, as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 12,00,000 to Rs. 15,00,000 per annum, depending on the post of Senior Consultant or Consultant.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts are offered on a contractual basis for the Indian Ports Association.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for the IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Indian Ports Association, which is www.ipa.org.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the address to send the application form for IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The specific address for sending the application form will be mentioned in the official notification PDF. Candidates should refer to it for submission details.
